title: Two Sum
description: Given an integer array and a target, return the indices of two numbers that add up to the target.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings, check whether one is an anagram of the other.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string, find the length of the longest substring that has no repeated characters.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth, the number of nodes on the longest path from root to a leaf.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree and two nodes, find their lowest common ancestor.

title: Number of Islands
description: Given a 2D grid of land and water, count the number of islands formed by connected land cells.

title: Course Schedule
description: Given the number of courses and prerequisite pairs, determine whether all courses can be finished.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Count the distinct ways to reach the top of n stairs.

title: Coin Change
description: Given coin values and an amount, find the minimum number of coins needed to make that amount.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given an array where each element is a stock price on a day, find the maximum profit from buying on one day and selling on a later day.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array, return a new array where each element is the product of all other elements, without using division.

title: Rotate Array
description: Given an array and a number k, rotate the array to the right by k positions.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given a list of intervals, merge all the overlapping ones and return the non-overlapping result.

title: Reverse String
description: Given an array of characters, reverse it in place without using extra memory.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string, check whether it reads the same forwards and backwards after ignoring spaces, punctuation and letter case.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Given a string, find the longest substring that is a palindrome.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given a list of words, group together the words that are anagrams of each other.

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, swap the left and right children of every node and return the root.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given a binary tree, return its node values level by level from left to right.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given a binary tree, check whether it follows the rules of a binary search tree.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree, find the length of the longest path between any two nodes in the tree.

title: Clone Graph
description: Given a node of a connected undirected graph, create a deep copy of the whole graph.

title: Rotting Oranges
description: Given a grid of fresh and rotten oranges, where rot spreads to neighbours each minute, find the time until all oranges are rotten.

title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
description: Given a grid of 0s and 1s, find the shortest path from the top-left to the bottom-right moving only through cells with 0, in any of 8 directions.

title: Flood Fill
description: Given an image grid, a starting cell and a new colour, fill the starting cell and every connected cell of the same colour.

title: House Robber
description: Given the money in each house on a street, find the maximum you can steal without robbing two neighbouring houses.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an array, find the length of the longest subsequence whose values are strictly increasing.

title: Unique Paths
description: A robot starts at the top-left of a grid and can only move right or down. Count the ways to reach the bottom-right corner.

title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Given two strings, find the length of the longest sequence of characters that appears in both in the same order.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given an array of bar heights, where each bar has width 1, calculate how much rain water gets trapped between the bars after it rains.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given two strings s and t, find the smallest substring of s that contains every character of t, including duplicates.

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
description: Given a binary tree, find the path between any two nodes that has the largest sum of node values. The path does not need to pass through the root.

title: Word Ladder
description: Given a start word, an end word and a word list, find the length of the shortest sequence that changes one letter at a time, where every step is a word from the list.

title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings, find the minimum number of insert, delete or replace operations needed to turn the first string into the second.
